title: Identity residue field is rational
statement: For a field k and a group scheme G over Spec k, the structural residue map k → κ(e) at the identity e is bijective, and the induced map Spec κ(e) → G equals the identity section after applying Spec to the structural map.

source.place: The rationality argument for the identity section

proof.text: Let a be the structural residue map and b the residue-field map induced by the identity section. Stalk-map composition and the section equation give a followed by b equal to id. Both field maps are injective, so a is surjective and b followed by a is id. The canonical factorization of a morphism from a field spectrum through its residue point, followed by contravariant Spec composition, gives Spec.map a followed by the identity section equal to fromSpecResidueField.

lean.statement:
theorem identity_residue_rational
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (G : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GrpObj G] :
    let x := unitSection G (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)
    let a := StructureSheaf.toStalk k (G.hom x) ≫ G.hom.stalkMap x ≫ G.left.residue x
    Function.Bijective a.hom ∧
      Spec.map a ≫ unitSection G = G.left.fromSpecResidueField x
